description: Update a feedback widget comment's status: "reviewed" once assessed, "resolved" when confirmed fixed (ideally after a checklist run proves it), "dismissed" sparingly. The dashboard reflects the change immediately.

feedback_id.description: Comment (feedback) UUID, the `id` returned by list_feedback.

status.description: The new status: new (nobody has looked yet), reviewed (assessed, still open), resolved (confirmed fixed) or dismissed (will not act on it).

name: update_feedback_status
title: Update comment status
